description: This Java class converts a DittoRuntimeException into an Akka HTTP HttpResponse, including status code, headers, and JSON entity.

classes.name: DittoRuntimeExceptionToHttpResponse
classes.description: A final immutable class that implements Function to convert DittoRuntimeException objects into HttpResponse objects suitable for HTTP responses.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DittoRuntimeExceptionToHttpResponse, ensuring the provided headerTranslator is not null.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Transforms a DittoRuntimeException into an HttpResponse, setting the status, headers, and JSON payload.

methods.name: getExternalHeadersFor
methods.description: Converts DittoHeaders into a list of Akka HTTP HttpHeader objects using the headerTranslator.
